data.name: mpd_role_spawn
data.arguments: {"role": "Explorer", "task": "list the top-level files of the current working directory"}

content.text:
role Explorer (complete)
summary: The workspace /tmp/mpd-delegation-gate-gCpnj9/ws-roles has zero top-level regular files. Its root holds only two hidden tool-state directories: .mpd/ (MPD runtime state) and .codegraph/ (codegraph index). All 21 files in the tree are nested under those two directories.
recommendation: Treat this workspace as a bare MPD/DSH state directory, not a code project: there is no source, no .git, and no manifest to read. If you need context about what the harness booted, start at /tmp/mpd-delegation-gate-gCpnj9/ws-roles/.mpd/verify/boot.json, then .mpd/logs/mpd-bootstrap.log and .mpd/logs/mpd-roles.log. Do not look for project source here.
details: METHOD: `glob *` and `glob **/*` over the workspace (glob's no-separator pattern matches basenames at any depth) returned the identical 21-path set, i.e. complete and well under the 100-path cap; hidden and ignored files are included by the tool. Directory existence was probed with `read` (a directory yields "not a regular file", a missing path yields "not found"). codegraph_explore over the same projectPath returned "No relevant code found", corroborating that there is no indexable source.

TOP LEVEL (confirmed):
- .mpd/    -> "not a regular file" = directory exists
- .codegraph/ -> "not a regular file" = directory exists
- .git, src/ -> "not found"
No regular file sits at depth 1.

FULL FILE INVENTORY (21, all nested):
- .codegraph/: .gitignore, codegraph.db, init.cooldown
- .mpd/logs/ (14): mpd-patch-guards.log, mpd-codegraph.log, mpd-tui.log, mpd-bootstrap.log, mpd-goal.log, mpd-verify.log, mpd-team-watchdog.log, mpd-ext.log, mpd-config.log, mpd-team-core.log, mpd-roster.log, mpd-mcp-lsp.log, mpd-dsh-adapter.log, mpd-roles.log
- .mpd/verify/boot.json
- .mpd/lsp/cclsp.json
- .mpd/team/watchdog/heartbeat/: session-session.jsonl, session-9458373e.jsonl

WHAT EACH AREA HOLDS (by path/symbol, contents not opened beyond the listing): .mpd/logs/* are per-subsystem MPD logs (patch guards, codegraph, TUI, bootstrap, goal, verify, team watchdog, extensions, config, team core, roster, MCP-LSP, DSH adapter, roles); .mpd/verify/boot.json is the harness boot record; .mpd/lsp/cclsp.json is LSP client configuration; .mpd/team/watchdog/heartbeat/*.jsonl are session heartbeat streams; .codegraph/* is the code-graph index store.

NOT FOUND / GAP: no top-level files whatsoever, so no manifest, README, AGENTS.md, .git, or source tree. A directory-only listing (e.g. `ls -la` via a shell) is unavailable to this read-only role; glob returns files but not directories, so additional empty top-level directories, if any, would not appear in this report. Probing only covered .git, src and the two found dirs.
evidence:
- glob "*" and glob "**/*" with path /tmp/mpd-delegation-gate-gCpnj9/ws-roles returned the same 21 nested paths and no depth-1 file
- read /tmp/mpd-delegation-gate-gCpnj9/ws-roles -> Error: not a regular file (root has no top-level regular file to read)
- read .../.mpd -> Error: not a regular file (directory exists); read .../.codegraph -> same
- read .../.git -> Error: not found; read .../src -> Error: not found
- codegraph_explore(projectPath=/tmp/mpd-delegation-gate-gCpnj9/ws-roles) -> "No relevant code found", i.e. no indexable source in the workspace
- grep "^$" over the workspace returned no matches (dot-directory contents not scanned by grep's ignore rules), so grep could not supplement the file listing
